name: Renderer visuals, step by step
body: Dean (2026-11-16): work through a list of renderer improvements in whatever order makes sense. Recommended order from the thread: HDR + tone mapping + bloom, image-based lighting / procedural sky, anti-aliasing, ambient occlusion, then fog and light shafts, softer shadows, surface detail, particles and a colour-grade hook. Rules: one small PR per effect with before/after screenshots; keep 60 fps on the platformer scene; expensive effects are toggleable through a quality setting that Nyx can set (and the editor settings where reasonable); every effect gets a guide page, tutorial comments and a decision in docs/decisions.md. Metal output and real-GPU frame times cannot be checked in the cloud.
